messages:
ana: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. Quick follow-ups re: last week's incident — I'm consolidating RCA links and a short owner/action list. Please ack and add ETAs.

ana: RCA: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-2026-314 — TL;DR: router memory leak + fallback not firing for ~15m

mike: Link works. Noted. @priya can you confirm if the rollback runbook triggered? :eyes:

priya: Runbook attempted but one step failed (kv-cache flush). Logs:
```
error: kv flush timeout 15s
```
Investigating root cause of the timeout.

sam: I'm reproducing mem growth locally with seq_len=2048 and long chat sessions. Will open a PR for extractor GC/trim by EOD.

mike: We need a canary rollout + short-term per-worker concurrency cap. @dave we should update the public SLO summary to reflect the change and the error-budget burn — can you own that?

dave: I can take SLO doc edits. Will have a draft by tomorrow 10am PT.

ana: Action list (high level):
1) priya — retry script fix + add postmortem log snippets to RCA (ETA: today 5pm)
2) sam — extractor PR with perf tests (ETA: EOD)
3) mike — gateway config patch + canary rollout plan (ETA: tomorrow morning)
4) dave — SLO doc update and exec summary (ETA: tomorrow 10am)
Please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept.

priya: Accepting :white_check_mark: I'll post the logs and link back here when done.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: id=canary-1958040000 leader=mike target=us-west-2-pool-1

mike: Noted. I'll run pre-rollout smoke at 08:30 PT — will post results.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/extractor/pull/472 — includes perf harness and initial fix. CC @mike

dave: Draft SLO update: https://docs.google.com/document/d/xyz — putting in suggested wording and risk note for leadership.

ana: Two clarifying questions raised during Q&A: 1) Are we comfortable with current fallback ordering? 2) Do we need a short-lived quota throttle at the gateway to protect control plane? Leaders wanted quick opinions.

priya: Fallback ordering today: model-variant -> region -> capacity-tier. My proposal: add a fast-fail short-circuit for known mem-growth patterns to reduce tail latency. I can prototype a change this week.

mike: Quota throttle: yes — recommend a soft throttle at API gateway that triggers on aggregate inflight and rejects with 429 fast. I'll prototype a circuit in gateway by EOD.

ana: If no objections I'll consolidate these actions into a GH issue and ping execs for visibility. Thanks all — please keep updates in this thread.

sam: ack :thumbsup:

dave: ack
